notes.title: 🧊 Pre-Alpha Release 0.005 – The Cold Undead 💀❄️
notes.notes: [h3]⚰️ [b]Undead Drop (Temporary Race)[/b][/h3][p]The Undead have risen. This mysterious race won't be available in the final game – but in Pre-Alpha, you get to toy around with them freely. Mix and match new parts in the character creator. See and feel.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45628343/2643023ff51fe5c2ae590f2cdf9b51f9f2a2b13f.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 [b]Stat System Rework[/b][/h3][p]All stats are now calculated based on your [b]Attributes[/b], [b]Class[/b], and [b]Background skills[/b]. No two characters will ever be the same. You might roll a tanky +5 CON Barbarian with expert-level Medicine and double HP… or end up with half stats across the board.[/p][p]Stats now include:[/p][list][*][p]Health[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina[/p][/*][*][p]Armor[/p][/*][*][p]Mana[/p][/*][*][p]Food[/p][/*][*][p]Thirst[/p][/*][*][p]Speed[/p][/*][*][p]Heat Resistance[/p][/*][*][p]Cold Resistance[/p][/*][*][p]Oxygen (now functional – try diving!)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🍀 [b]New Attribute: Luck[/b][/h3][p]Luck is back. And it matters.[/p][p]Your Luck stat is now calculated from a D20 roll with Wisdom, Intelligence, and Charisma as modifiers. This hidden stat will be rolled in situations where fate is uncertain – for example, when you die. Which leads us to...[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🪓 [b]Skilltree Progress[/b][/h3][p]These skilltree abilities are now functional:[/p][list][*][p]XP Boost I & II[/p][/*][*][p]Food/Thirst Resistance I & II[/p][/*][*][p]Oxygen Boost[/p][/*][*][p]Fall Resistance[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🦴 [b]The Nerf System (Lose Limbs on Death)[/b][/h3][p]When you die, a D20 is rolled against your Luck stat. If you fail, you might lose:[/p][list][*][p]Eyes[/p][/*][*][p]Ears[/p][/*][*][p]Hands[/p][/*][*][p]Legs[/p][/*][/list][p]Lost limbs are replaced with things like hooks and peg legs. These affect your gameplay (in good and bad ways) but also give you [b]Reputation[/b]. NPCs will now recognize such scars as marks of a seasoned warrior.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💪 [b]Attribute & Race Skill Rework[/b][/h3][p]Attributes now display: 0 (+1, +0 on Human) → Base + Race + Class modifiers.[/p][p]When creating your character, each stat is rolled using [b]4d6 (drop lowest)[/b] and bonuses are applied after. Each race now has [b]2 unique race skills[/b] to diversify playstyles.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 [b]Fixes & Polish[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New Hunger/Thirst icons[/p][/*][*][p]Wraps work correctly on female models[/p][/*][*][p]Male is now 100% male (not 50%)[/p][/*][*][p]You now respawn with your last equipped item[/p][/*][*][p]Glide → land = auto re-equip weapon[/p][/*][*][p]No duplicate character names allowed[/p][/*][*][p]Reputation now influences dialogue success[/p][/*][*][p]Hotbar reworked with new mount stat bars[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌐 [b]Multiplayer & Lobby Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Host now exits lobbies correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby audio improved[/p][/*][*][p]Avatars now load properly[/p][/*][*][p]Friend panel no longer displays blank buttons[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]☠️ [b]Fall Damage[/b][/h3][p]We added fall damage! Elves have a better baseline for it, and there's a [b]Fall Resistance[/b] skill in the tree. Test it... but don’t fall from too high.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧾 [b]Icons Overhaul[/b][/h3][p]All UI icons have been replaced! (Except for Athletics – we kept those in for comparison. Let us know which you prefer.)[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🪦 [b]Gravestone System + Death Animation[/b][/h3][p]When you die:[/p][list][*][p]You drop all inventory items (equipped gear is safe)[/p][/*][*][p]A gravestone appears where you fell[/p][/*][*][p]Only your [b]latest[/b] gravestone is saved, but others still appear[/p][/*][/list][p]...also, death now looks more fun. 🎭[/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45628343/46f4e1a8c1b0c34aafd04cf54026048f2566131d.png"][/img][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45628343/2a1bf4ebd0a450ced55dd2604ba17e1c2cf7863d.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌌 [b]Nights Reworked[/b][/h3][p]Nights are now brighter, more atmospheric, and take place under a stunning fantasy sky. You can finally explore without running into trees. (Hopefully.)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45628343/0652154e3fd8bd4779283d0dcff47e256c7f051f.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Join the conversation![/h3][p]We’re shaping this world with you. Report bugs, suggest improvements, or share screenshots with the community![/p][p]See you in the Realms – and don’t forget to bring a spare leg. 🦿[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Pre-Alpha Release 0.003 – "Skeleton Awakens"
notes.notes:
[h3][b]⚰️ New Playable Race: Skeletons[/b][/h3][p]We’ve added a brand new playable race – the [b]Skeletons[/b]!
Customize your character with new skeletal parts and embrace the bone-chilling vibes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628343/ab04d1f1259334c598e2bac2035b10e5b96c27b6.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🌳 Skill Tree Beginnings[/b][/h3][p]The foundation of the Skill Tree system has been laid![/p][list][*][p]The [b]Attribute Tree UI[/b] is now functional[/p][/*][*][p]Backend systems are under development[/p][/*][*][p]Early version available for testing[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628343/ed0100f608de343c2054e05b16b365e11acc35e1.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🎒 Inventory System (Early Preview)[/b][/h3][p]A basic version of the inventory has been added.[/p][list][*][p]Not fully functional yet[/p][/*][*][p]Syncs with the Weapon Wheel[/p][/*][*][p]More features coming in the next update![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45628343/b86d4b03c61055d6aeabfd9c81a02e5c45e27159.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][p]We've been hunting bugs! Here's what we squashed:[/p][list][*][p]🌀 [b]Weapon Wheel:[/b] Selecting an item now locks the wheel from cycling further[/p][/*][*][p]🌑 [b]Shadow Material Issue:[/b] Characters now properly update when entering shadow zones[/p][/*][*][p]⚙️ [b]Display Settings:[/b] Settings now persist between scenes[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]🔧 Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][p]A bunch of minor but impactful updates:[/p][list][*][p]✅ Added [b]Apply Changes[/b] button to Display Settings[/p][/*][*][p]🌞 Introduced [b]Day & Night Cycle[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🪓 Pressing [b]4[/b] now equips [b]Erik’s Axe[/b][/p][/*][*][p]⚡ Major character [b]optimization[/b] to reduce bugs and increase performance[/p][/*][*][p]🆘 Added an [b]in-game helper overlay[/b] at startup for keybindings[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]📣 Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Inventory and Skill Tree are [b]work in progress[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Some UI animations may feel unresponsive or placeholder-like[/p][/*][*][p]More polish and balance coming soon![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]🙏 Thank You![/b][/h3][p]We appreciate everyone testing and sending feedback 💛
Join our Discord to share your thoughts and get sneak peeks of upcoming features:[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/TgDHGmeHD8"]https://discord.gg/TgDHGmeHD8[/url][/p]
